chapter: Arrangements, repertoire and the last band
title: Fats Domino's brother-in-law and the lost bag of orchestrations
summary: Laurent complains about a pianist who will not hire the brother-in-law who taught him, and tells of leaving $200 of orchestrations on a streetcar.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Last time I took Fess over there Me and Fess been there again Then I passed that several times by myself Well we played good violin together Fats Domino's brother-in-law Was playing guitar with me then Harrison Oh Harrison The one taught him to play the piano And he won't give him a job You know that's dirty Now he taught him to play the piano By chord And showed him how to make the chords On the piano He don't

He won't give his brother-in-law a job right now. That's how big his head done, guy. The boy would show him how to play. Won't give him a job. Now, you know, that ain't right. I wouldn't call that fair. You gave me something that you didn't have to give me. You give it to me to make my bread. I made bread with it. I made big bread with it. And I'm not going to give you nothing. It ain't like that. Oh, it ain't like that. Oh, it ain't like that. Oh, it ain't like that. Man, I love my piano player lost a black repertoire like this for me with about $200 worth of music in it. Left it on the street car. And I called. The street car was in the next block going. I went right across the street from where we got off the car. And I called the... the... bond.

I notified the night supervisor. I said, we left a repertoire of music on. I said every piece of music got my name, address and telephone number on it. So you can't go wrong. I gave him the name, everything. I never did get that. Somebody picked it up and got off to the next stop.
I guess. I had about $200. I had orchestration cost me two and a half. Two dollars in there.
Yeah. I was getting music from Leo Feist about a year. And then I was buying orchestrations. Yeah, in there. All over. I was buying orchestrations.
